subject.title: feat(system-agent): auto-hatch into the agent after fresh setup

question: Is direct current-head proof of the fresh web setup → agent chat → populated hatch draft flow required before this onboarding feature merges?
rationale: The implementation has focused regression coverage and resolves the prior functional findings, but the contributor explicitly confirms that the user-visible web handoff has not been demonstrated in a real run; the protected maintainer label requires a human merge decision.

options.title: Require direct web proof
options.body: Request a redacted recording, screenshots with diagnostic context, or live-output transcript from a fresh setup through the visible agent composer before merging.

options.title: Accept seam coverage
options.body: Merge based on the typed protocol, focused tests, and adjacent live checks while accepting the remaining cross-surface proof gap.

recommendation.title: Require direct web proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted recording, screenshots with diagnostic context, or live-output transcript from a fresh setup through the visible agent composer before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current onboarding/custodian implementation trail and can provide or coordinate the missing exact-flow proof.
